control_contract: Apply phi_leg=0 or pi synchronously to every intraleg hopping while pair-conversion amplitudes are unchanged. This is a new dynamic hardware resource; static local pi-flux cancellation does not by itself establish its availability.
decision: Direct Peierls-sign modulation exactly realizes the ideal echo Hamiltonian in the registered microscopic model. It is a conditional control bridge pending a derivation of synchronous phase-switch bandwidth, errors and effects on pair conversion.
claim_boundary: This establishes no experimental implementation, protected phase, edge mode, 2D code, braid, non-Abelian statistics, universality or fault tolerance.
